title: CVR/CRM corpus schema
description: Ground-truth data contract. The build may not originate a fact; every analytic field must carry a source_ref that resolves into sources.json. Verification vocabulary is deliberately narrow so that 'unknown' cannot masquerade as 'false'.

verification.description: How the value in this record was established. primary-verified means the actual instrument, report, or article text was read. secondary-only means it rests on a summary, mirror, or third-party account. brief-only means it entered from the research briefs and has not been externally checked. not-documented means a genuine search failed and the absence is the finding.

licence.description: Reproduce-or-cite determination. This project seeks no permissions, so 'cite-only' is a design constraint, not a pending task.

basis.description: The authority's own published terms or statutory position that supports the status.

attribution.description: Exact attribution wording required when reproducing.

carve_out.description: Embedded third-party material excluded from the grant.

sourced_value.description: Any factual value that will render on screen. Value plus provenance travel together so the gate can check them as one unit.

jurisdiction_field.description: Never null. An unknown must be the explicit marker so a reader distinguishes 'no protection' from 'not established'.

downgraded.description: True where this source supplied at least one demonstrably wrong value; every claim resting on it inherits reduced confidence.

quotation.description: verbatim is stored and never rendered. rendered must be derivable from verbatim by applying only the declared redactions and elisions. Any other difference fails the build.

locator.description: Page, paragraph, or section within the source.

elisions.description: At most one internal elision per quotation. Two is a reassembly, not an elision.

necessity.description: Why exact wording is required. a=wording is the object of analysis; b=paraphrase would alter legal or evidentiary meaning; c=wording is evidence of the author's own stance; d=contested formulation that must be shown in the parties' own words.

label.description: Operator and flight number only. No crew names anywhere.

jurisdiction.description: ISO country code of the investigating authority.

basis.description: What the cited report itself counted, in its own terms.

subsequent.description: Deaths after the report's count, separately sourced.

ground.description: Included in reported; identified separately wherever present.

cvr_role.description: What the investigating authority did with the recording, attributed. Never the project's own reading.

transcript.description: Whether transcript material can be reproduced, which follows the report's licence, not the project's wishes.

selection_basis.description: Why this accident is in the corpus. Published to the reader.

sensitivity.description: quarantined = unsettled matter, active proceedings, or living relatives organised; final-moments material collapsed by default.

regime_class.description: The spine of the comparison. separation-principle = investigation is procedurally separated from liability, but no express bar on evidentiary use. express-bar = statute prohibits use of recorder material as evidence. discretionary = release governed by disclosure exemptions rather than an aviation-specific rule.

cut.description: The record of what the piece does not say. Rendered to the reader.
